CONSENT CALENDAR
Approve the terms and conditions of Amendment No. 1 to the Childcare Lease to modify the scholarship program procedures
Approve an increase of $117,517 to procure additional ductile iron pipe, realign the pipe and for additional traffic controls and support
Award Contract No. WD-2906 to the responsible bidder, Mitchell Engineering to replace a section of 12-inch diameter water main
Award Contract No. WD-2883R to the responsible bidder, Rodan Builders, Inc to provide security upgrades at the Millbrae Campus
Approve a Greenhouse Gas-Free Energy Contract for CleanPowerSF and authorize the General Manager to seek Board of Supervisors approval of the contract
Approve an attestation of veracity for Hetch Hetchy Power’s 2023 Power Source Disclosure Reports and Power Content Label
Approve an attestation of veracity for CleanPowerSF’s 2023 Power Source Disclosure Reports and Power Content Label
Approve the novation of Contract No. PRO.0054.A, to transfer the existing contract from Woodard & Curran-Hydroconsult Engineers Inc., JV to Woodard & Curran, Inc.
Accept work performed by JMB Construction to complete punch list work associated with the Pacific Gas and Electric Company power service to the facility
Approve and authorize the General Manager to execute a new 10-year water service contract with the United States Department of Energy to Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory
Approve Amendment No. 3 to Contract No. PRO.0096 to continue providing specialized construction management services for the Mountain Tunnel Improvements Project
Authorize the General Manager to seek approval from the Board of Supervisors to extend and increase the delegation of authority to execute power supply contracts
Award Contract No. DB-138 to PCL Construction, Inc., to design and construct the Biogas Utilization Project to use of the biogas by converting it to renewable natural gas for pipeline injection
Approve an increase of $385,000 to Contract No. WW-739 to perform additional large diameter sewer cleaning
